text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraph structure with separate reasons","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups ideas into coherent paragraphs and develops them in a more orderly way."},{"evidence":"topic sentences like \"A teachers main job...\" and \"Learning and understanding something new...\"","quality":"idea development","description":"The essay explains its points with fuller support and elaboration rather than brief unsupported claims."},{"evidence":"consistent persuasive focus on benefits to students, teachers, and community","quality":"coherence","description":"The essay stays on one line of argument and connects each paragraph back to the main claim."},{"evidence":"more controlled sentence flow across longer sentences","quality":"syntactic control","description":"The essay shows better command of sentence structure, with fewer fragments and less disruptive breakdowns in meaning."},{"evidence":"fewer misspellings and grammar glitches than B","quality":"language control","description":"The essay has somewhat stronger control of spelling, agreement, and word form even though errors remain."}]}
